title: Full Copy of the Initial Input
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic machine over the Boolean alphabet and let $x$ be a Boolean word. The copied payload vector with count $|x|+1$ equals the head-centered payload vector of $M$'s initial configuration on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite deterministic machine over Booleans
replaced:
For every binary machine $M$ and word $x$, the copied payloads of count
$|x| + 1$ coincide with the head-centered payload vectors of the initial
configuration of $M$ on $x$: the input lane carries the complete virtual input
including both boundary tags, and every work lane is blank.
